entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: How dare he declare the[n]Phantom Thieves are criminals!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: As the administrator of the[n]Phantom Aficionado Website,[n]I can't stay quiet about this.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm going to show Akechi how[n]people online really feel!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll change up the survey[n]question tomorrow morning.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Justice is with the Phantom[n]Thieves! Keep on doing what[n]you do best!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Why is he of all people getting angry[n]about this?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, he means the survey on the[n]Phan-Site, right? I guess we should[n]look forward to it.
